rule_proposal: nothing_to_amortize (proposal): when the company stated amortization 0 in its last reporting years and no later 10-K prints any amortizing intangible (no line, no fact, no balance), the cell is hidden as nothing_to_amortize with the last stated-zero accession as evidence; not covered by the absence allowlist, so needs a ruling
